Long Line Rescue.name: Long Line Rescue
Long Line Rescue.description: The user traces one continuous, controlled beam across the face of a collapsed structure, cutting several small openings for air and access without touching the people inside. Rescuers can reach those openings for the rest of the scene. The user needs a clear view of each cut line, and the extended firing leaves their abdomen painful for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.
